title: Egolite retained requirement contract closure
description: Fail-closed static contract for exactly fifteen owner-routed Egolite requirements. Semantic authority remains in each exact owner_doc and PlanUnit. Validation creates no command, handler, EventRecord, runtime, browser, native, security-attack, benchmark, readiness, or implementation proof.

safe_human_text.$comment: This pattern rejects common secret/path/raw-hash forms only. The owner-required human-copy scanner must additionally reject context-specific raw IDs, code, paths, and secrets; schema success is not content-safety proof.

hbu_005.title: HBU-005 capability-specific Browser Program digest registry
hbu_005.$comment: JSON Schema cannot compare compact_digest_bytes to byte_budget or help_emitted_bytes to help_byte_budget, recompute hashes/signatures, prove same-input Host stability, prove help omission from a compiled prompt, or validate stale epochs. The prompt compiler/registry validator must enforce those invariants.

hbu_013.title: HBU-013 exact shared human-step projection
hbu_013.$comment: The closed record structurally provides one canonical value for all five exact surfaces and forbids per-surface override fields. A projection join validator must still prove live consumers use it byte-for-byte, visual truncation exposes the full value, replay does not regenerate copy, and success is backed by an owner receipt.

brw_010.title: BRW-010 focus-independent Browser continuation
brw_010.$comment: Static identity and policy fields cannot prove a live server-owned Browser Program continues through OS/app/tab/panel focus transitions; the four-state runtime focus matrix remains required.

brw_011.title: BRW-011 truthful Browser fidelity profiles
brw_011.$comment: Profile identities and static semantics are non-swappable. Runtime timing, composition, throttling, platform/CEF behavior, declared-tolerance measurement, focus theft, degradation, and interruption evidence require empirical execution.

scm_005.title: SCM-005 included Git and Jujutsu baselines
scm_005.$comment: The schema requires separate ordered Git and Jujutsu baseline rows and all target classes. It cannot probe PATH, install or activate a tool, validate Host/Environment existence, or prove provenance/current generation at runtime.

scm_019.title: SCM-019 five-domain workspace conflict plan
scm_019.$comment: The schema requires every claim domain, stable identity ingredients, decision, lease/currentness refs, isolation proof, and receipt. Live collision detection, lease freshness, double-lease exclusion, deterministic adjudication, and proof applicability require runtime validation.

ori_002.title: ORI-002 capability-gated Origin create visibility
ori_002.$comment: The schema fixes marketing negatives, signed/current capability evidence fields, retained baseline, and no-Public-dispatch semantics. It cannot verify provider capability freshness/signature or prove a GUI/adapter does not optimistically enable or dispatch.

ori_020.title: ORI-020 complete typed API fallback
ori_020.$comment: Structural fields require all five cases and complete-proof ingredients. Custom validation must compare decoded bytes to the threshold, prove route completeness, enumerate exact commits, validate CLI version/schema output, and ensure unsupported operations cannot report success.

irt_008.title: IRT-008 external installation maintenance ownership
irt_008.$comment: Schema consts cannot prove real ownership, delegation currency/scope/revocation, one-operation consent identity, or absence of package-manager effects. Runtime ownership and mutation admission remain mandatory.

irt_009.title: IRT-009 identical installation-operation coalescing
irt_009.$comment: JSON Schema fixes the complete fingerprint vocabulary and per-waiter fields but cannot compare operation fingerprints, validate waiter freshness/authority, prove cancellation detachment, or enforce package-manager-root serialization.

irt_010.title: IRT-010 durable Tool Store and isolated profiles
irt_010.$comment: Static refs cannot prove mount presence/currentness, data survival across image/pod replacement, corruption/partial-root handling, isolation, migration, provenance, broker verification, no-secret storage, or successful reconciliation.

irt_011.title: IRT-011 attenuated credential attachment
irt_011.$comment: The schema prohibits raw/copied secret fields and requires exact scope/generation/revocation/broker refs. Broker/runtime validation must prove expiry ordering, current revocation, ref authenticity, exact scope matches, lease enforcement, secret isolation, authentication, and readiness.

sec_003.title: SEC-003 minimum Browser-state export
sec_003.$comment: Closed fields and non-secret ref patterns cannot prove redaction effectiveness or absence of cookie/storage/auth secret bytes from exports, receipts, artifacts, logs, model context, persistence, or display. Secret-exfiltration and process-isolation tests remain required.

sec_007.title: SEC-007 public ingress PM API only
sec_007.$comment: Endpoint-class policy cannot prove live bind/port/firewall/Funnel/reverse-proxy topology, authentication, rate limiting, body bounds, generation fencing, pre-hydration ordering, or attack resistance.

sec_008.title: SEC-008 actual network-effect authorization
sec_008.$comment: Schema consts cannot intercept actual network effects, compare a permit to a request, resolve DNS, detect rebinding/SSRF, reauthorize redirects/reconnects/follow-ups, run FileSafe, or prove no bypass. Dynamic network and attack tests remain required.
